description: A burned-out flyer hulk dragged off to the edge of the strip and left to the weather: wings gone, cockpit a black socket, the whole frame settling slowly into the hardpan. Somebody's welded a row of empty fuel cans along a wing stub as a boundary marker. It's the closest thing the Reach keeps to a memorial, and the closest thing it keeps to a warning: come in too fast, too heavy, or too wanted, and this is the far end of the runway.
name: the burned-out flyer hulk
